title: Workforce Pell Eligibility Screener
description: Estimates Workforce Pell Grant award for short-term credential programs (150–599 clock hours, 8–14 weeks) under OBBBA P.L. 119-21 (effective July 1, 2026). Inputs: AGI or SAI, family size, dependency status, clock hours, program weeks, occupation category, optional program cost. Outputs: estimated SAI, base Pell eligibility, proration ratio, Workforce Pell award, program cost coverage, lifetime Pell usage note. New OBBBA rules: SAI cutoff raised to $14,790; bachelor's degree holders now eligible.
data_vintage: ED Pell Grant 2026-27 (Dear Colleague Letter Jan 2026); OBBBA P.L. 119-21 (July 4, 2025); Workforce Pell Final Rule (March 9, 2026)
regulatory_citations: ED Dear Colleague Letter 2026-01-30 — 2026-27 Pell Grant max $7,395 / min $740
OBBBA P.L. 119-21 (signed July 4, 2025) — SAI eligibility cutoff expanded to $14,790
Federal Register 2026-04520 (March 9, 2026) — Workforce Pell Final Rule
ED Illustrative Pell Calculation Examples (November 2025) — clock-hour proration formula
